name: Warom Technology Incorporated Company
summary: Warom Technology Incorporated Company researches and develops, manufactures, and supplies explosion-proof electric apparatus and professional lighting equipment in China and internationally. It offers explosion proof light fittings, including linear light, highbay lowbay light, pendant light, and caution spotlight fittings, as well as floodlights, street lamps, and solar lighting; explosion proof electrical equipment comprising illumination switches, junction and terminal boxes, and plugs and switches; explosion proof control equipment that include position switches, control stations, and control unit systems; and explosion proof distribution boxes, such as motor switches, distribution boxes…
